name: What is involved in the pre-construction phase for custom framing?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the pre-construction phase for custom framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pre-construction phase for custom framing involves several critical steps. These include finalizing architectural and structural engineering plans, obtaining all necessary permits from the local building department, and conducting a thorough site assessment. We also coordinate with other trades, such as foundation contractors, to ensure a seamless transition and prepare for material delivery and staging.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pre-construction for custom framing involves finalizing plans, securing permits, site assessment, and coordinating with other trades for material delivery.
